The embossed Hemingray No 40 marking and its solid, pressed glass construction exude vintage industrial charm, making it an ideal addition for collectors or anyone drawn to historic utility glassware. The insulator's robust design and glossy finish reflect the manufacturing techniques widely used in the United States in the early-to-mid 20th century. This singular piece stands out for its bold color and unique visual appeal, whether displayed as part of a collection or repurposed in creative projects. The insulator shows minor signs of age and practical utility, with some inner wood residue visible at the base, but remains structurally sound with no noted cracks. Add this authentic example of industrial history to your display or upcycle it into distinctive home decor. Actual condition as pictured.
